lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: (nods “yes”) Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: And what do you see again?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Her jeep.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: And you’re sure the big garage door is open? You didn’t go in the little door.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: (shakes head “no”) No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: So you see her jeep and then what happens? Does he what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: He opens the back door.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK and what does he say?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: And told me to help him.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Da, do you ask him a question who is this, or, what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. Tell me what he said.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: He said that it’s a girl that he was kinda pee’d off at.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he say, who, who it was?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Teresa Halbach.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Why was he pee’d off at her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: I think he probably told ya. So just be honest. We already know.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: He’s obviously not holding anything back from you. He had you come ta see this.
